integrity: Complete arbitrary-dimensional symbolic proof with direct exhaustive small finite-field verification; no independent mathematical validation or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only uniformly sampled labeled invertible upper-triangular structure matrices over binary finite fields, and field-rational idempotents; full GL, odd characteristic, and isomorphism-class sampling excluded. Possible older random triangular semilinear rank/space literature is a priority risk. Van Peski (2024) covers closely related triangular-matrix rank distributions and may imply the binary-field special case; its full text was inaccessible.
title: Field-size-universal idempotent laws for triangular perfect evolution algebras in characteristic two
